LanguageData.RK_Gene_SmallBody.label: small body
LanguageData.RK_Gene_SmallBody.description: Carriers of this gene have a small frame. Having a small frame reduces makes carrying a bunch of items more difficult without assistance.
LanguageData.RK_Gene_Nimble.label: nimble
LanguageData.RK_Gene_Nimble.description: Carriers of this gene have sharp senses that allow them to respond more quickly to incoming threats.
LanguageData.RK_Gene_PoorEyesight.label: poor eyesight
LanguageData.RK_Gene_PoorEyesight.description: Carriers of this gene have poor eyesight. They take longer to aim and suffer reduced accuracy when forced to fire at long distances.
LanguageData.RK_Gene_FragilePain.label: pain sensitivity
LanguageData.RK_Gene_FragilePain.description: Carriers of this gene have a sensitivity to pain, feeling the pain of even small injuries that would otherwise go unnoticed.
LanguageData.RK_Gene_GoodGardening.label: gardening talent
LanguageData.RK_Gene_GoodGardening.description: Carriers of this gene are more skilled at harvesting plants.
LanguageData.RK_Skin_PureWhite.label: pure white skin
LanguageData.RK_Skin_PureWhite.description: Carriers of this gene have pure white skin.
LanguageData.RK_Gene_LargeEars.label: large round ears
LanguageData.RK_Gene_LargeEars.description: Carriers of this gene grow large, round ears.
LanguageData.RK_Gene_ThinTail.label: slender tail
LanguageData.RK_Gene_ThinTail.description: Carriers of this gene grow smooth, slender tails.
LanguageData.RK_Gene_CuteFace.label: cute face
LanguageData.RK_Gene_CuteFace.description: Carriers of this gene have facial features that give off a cute impression. It helps them form social relationships, but does make them appear less threatening when trying to act serious during negotiations.
